newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle sales $64, unchanged - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle sales $64, unchanged - USDA.

text.p: DODGE CITY, July 16 (Reuder) - Trade was moderate, with slaughter steers and heifers steady with late Tuesday, USDA said. Inquiry and demand good.
Confirmed - 10,200 Last week - 700 Last year - none
Wk to date- 63,900 Last week - 74,900 Last year - 13,300
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1260 lbs 64.00; pen 1250 lb Holsteins 57.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1175 lbs 64.00; pen mixed Commercial and Choice 1140 lb heifers and heiferettes 63.00.

Sales confirmed on 3,300 slaughter steers and 6,900 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 63,900 head confirmed including 21,200 head or about 33 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
